_comment: Rename this file to streaming.json and fill in your values. streaming.json is git-ignored and will never be committed.
_YouTubeStreamKey_help: Your YouTube Live stream key. Find it in YouTube Studio → Go Live → Stream key.
_OBSPath_help: Full path to obs64.exe. Adjust if you installed OBS to a custom location.
_OBSProfileName_help: Name of the OBS profile configured for YouTube streaming. Create this profile in OBS → Profile → New.
_OBSSceneCollection_help: Name of the OBS scene collection that uses Game Capture (not Display Capture) and Application Audio Capture scoped to the game executable only.
_GameProcessNames_help: Process names to watch (e.g. ["MyGame.exe", "AnotherGame.exe"]). Leave empty [] to auto-detect any new full-screen application.
